<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Administrative and civic policy:</strong> The Election Commission has eased the voter notice process for senior citizens and ailing voters, while the Union Power Minister clarified that prepaid smart meters are not mandatory for consumers.</li>

</ul>
